title: v0.3-R option-C live recurrence closure development transition
summary: Supersede the unreleasable v1 final-answer transition with a six-life, three-arm, recurrence-closure-only GPU development experiment. The thinker frontier changes only trusted view selection; its tuple and metadata never reach the model. All live writes remain provisional, and exact witness-bound closure is labeled only by an isolated post-MEMORY_1 scorer. No final question, final thinker, answer, RELEASE, LoRA, online admission, follow-up, or claim promotion exists in scope.
system_thesis: Test the narrow causal return edge needed by the larger dream-memory-think thesis: whether goal-conditioned thinking can allocate later bounded experience so the same general model forms a useful local connection. This transition isolates connection formation before parametric compression or downstream behavior and preserves the project claim that intelligence is a property of the full recurrent flow rather than a hidden solver or verifier.

nodes.before: Shared WAKE/REACTIVATE/SLEEP may apply online public-evidence admission and support promotion.
nodes.after: Execute one physical target-blind prefix per life; every parsed non-PASS write is append-only provisional and no truth/admission outcome exists during cognition.
nodes.rationale: Remove the ontology-teacher and rejection-sampling channel while retaining recurrent connection proposals.

nodes.before: One thinker may eventually participate in a final-answer transition.
nodes.after: One prompt-complete typed THINK_0 per life, at most 12 provider operations, terminates only REQUEST_DREAM or DEFER and projects at most one non-evidentiary frontier.
nodes.rationale: The current machine certifies a one-edge recurrence request, not the paired counterfactual answer.

nodes.after: Render call-local E/M/X/N aliases bound outside cognition to canonical source hashes; reject unknown, duplicated, cross-call, or type-wrong aliases.
nodes.rationale: Preserve exact provenance without requiring the model to copy 64-character hashes.

nodes.before: The full own or distractor tuple can appear in RETURN_SLEEP provider bytes.
nodes.after: Clone exact MEMORY_0/THINK_0 bytes into no_feedback, own_selector, and matched_distractor; only the trusted selector consumes the frontier and emits a bounded public view.
nodes.rationale: Make feedback a view-allocation treatment rather than answer/query copying.

nodes.before: Provider sees selection focus and later support status may steer calls.
nodes.after: Provider sees only generic prompt-complete DREAM instructions, one selected public trigger, at most six pre-existing neighbors, and local aliases; all writes remain provisional.
nodes.rationale: Isolate the causal effect of selected evidence while eliminating online truth feedback.

nodes.before: Reveal final question after MEMORY_1, run final thinkers, and score paired answers/releases.
nodes.rationale: Option C measures recurrence closure only; the current theorem cannot certify the conjunctive final answer.

nodes.after: After MEMORY_1 and raw proposal freeze, score raw exact and public-witness-bound closure, polarity, citations, near misses, and arm/control deltas without routing cognition or another run.
nodes.rationale: Measure exact closure without turning a verifier into the live search policy.

nodes.after: Derive mandatory artifact classes/cardinalities/referential edges from frozen schedule and baseline manifests, not producer done.json.
nodes.rationale: Producer hashes cannot prove that omitted artifact classes never existed.

nodes.after: Use atomic started/progress/done-or-failed markers, verified resumable barriers, 12-hour watchdog, artifact pull/verification, and unconditional human stop.
nodes.rationale: Enable unattended execution without delegating scientific authority to the watchdog.

acceptance_tests.setup: Search exact workflow, prompt, request, parser, artifact inventory, and trajectory bytes for final-question, final-answer, RELEASE, answer-valve, LoRA, or transport paths and attempt to inject each field.
acceptance_tests.expected: All are absent or fail closed before a provider call; only recurrence closure can be scored.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Option C is contaminated by the deferred final-behavior or transport experiment.

acceptance_tests.setup: Exercise every exact DREAM/THINK operation, malformed/extra fields, 64-character source IDs, alias permutations, unknown/cross-call/type-wrong aliases, and private sentinels.
acceptance_tests.expected: Prompts are complete, valid short aliases resolve to exact hashes, semantic results are permutation invariant, and all attacks reject without repair.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Provider behavior depends on undocumented scaffolding or brittle/hash-copy shortcuts.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate tuple, query key, goal/vocabulary/life/arm IDs, own/distractor identity, ranking scores, target, and selector rationale while holding the selected view fixed.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exact provider request/config/parser/receipt bytes remain identical; changing the selected view changes only bound public content and local alias permutation.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The model can copy or decode the requested conclusion/treatment.

acceptance_tests.setup: Across sixteen adaptive repeated/permuted/wrong/near-miss RETURN_SLEEP calls attempt online admission, status promotion, rejection feedback, deletion, supersession mutation, retry, and proposal-dependent scheduling.
acceptance_tests.expected: All parsed writes remain immutable provisional rows; events append; no truth/status/rationale affects later bytes or slots.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The live loop contains a hidden verifier or rejection-sampling search oracle.

acceptance_tests.setup: Mutate private/final truth before commit, swap score packets early, use wrong connector/polarity/endpoints/citations, and attempt scorer-triggered retry or memory rewrite.
acceptance_tests.expected: Cognition bytes are invariant; scorer starts only after complete freeze, distinguishes raw from witness-bound closure, rejects wrong joins, writes separate labels, and has no routing authority.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Closure is supplied or selected by the scorer rather than proposed by the model.

acceptance_tests.setup: Independently enumerate every own/distractor candidate set and compare the eight predeclared opportunity/difficulty fields before model execution.
acceptance_tests.expected: Pairs satisfy the frozen equality/stratification rule or invalidate without outcome-adaptive replacement; full manifests are hash-bound.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Own-versus-distractor deltas reflect easier evidence opportunities rather than query-guided allocation.

acceptance_tests.setup: Run 1000 pairs plus rendered-text/order/ID/scorer-coordinate/canonical/status/joined-feature audits and no-model tuple-copy, query-copy, masked, citation-permutation, wrong-connector, deterministic-retrieval, canonical-string and compiler controls.
acceptance_tests.expected: Every survivor and compiler contribution is reported; no forbidden provider-visible shortcut predicts hidden collision truth above the frozen criterion.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Apparent recurrence closure can be attributed to formatting, compiler, query copy, or population leakage.

acceptance_tests.setup: Generate heterogeneous six-life schedules independently, execute a dry fake provider, and inject missing, duplicated, reordered, padded, cross-life, or cross-arm calls.
acceptance_tests.expected: Exactly 802 physical recurrent DREAM calls reconcile; THINK is at most 72 physical operations without padding; shared prefixes are physical once and arm-attributed exactly.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The announced causal schedule differs from the executed job.

acceptance_tests.setup: Build frozen manifests for 6 full-context, 96 iterative-RAG, shared wake-only/target-blind/no-feedback, and zero-model retrieval/query-copy/compiler/oracle conditions with exact ceilings/resets/early terminals.
acceptance_tests.expected: 102 additional model calls and all shared/zero-call attributions, actual tokens, top-k, wall time, and compiler assistance reconcile separately from 802/72.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: The organism is compared against unspecified or compute-unfair closure competitors.

acceptance_tests.setup: Send prompt/config/reset bytes different from the ledger, forge receipts/tokens/timestamps, reuse state, or mismatch scheduled/provider/parser/proposal/alias rows.
acceptance_tests.expected: DREAM and THINK both fail closed; every physical and attributed experiment slot has an exact authoritative bijection.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Reported calls are not the isolated calls that actually reached the model.

acceptance_tests.setup: Derive required artifacts from reviewed manifests, then omit, duplicate, reorder, rewrite, orphan, or add unreferenced calls, aliases, selectors, checkpoints, scores, reviews, markers, baselines, or trajectories while keeping producer hashes valid.
acceptance_tests.expected: Independent verifier rejects every incomplete or referentially inconsistent job and only accepts exact required cardinalities.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: done.json can hide missing evidence or silently redefine completeness.

acceptance_tests.setup: Crash before/after each phase barrier, expire pollers, repeat start/status, stale heartbeat, corrupt progress, create both/no terminal markers, and exceed 12 hours.
acceptance_tests.expected: Atomic markers and verified barriers resume infrastructure safely or stop/escalate; science is never skipped, changed, inferred complete, or automatically rerun.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: An unattended night can idle, duplicate science, or be falsely reported successful.

acceptance_tests.setup: Freeze every implementation, prompt, schema, model, schedule, baseline, inventory, workflow, intake, and test byte; obtain independent fresh Fable and Sol reviews and mutate one byte afterward.
acceptance_tests.expected: Both reviewers approve identical hashes; mutation or either rejection/escalation stops before sync.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Partial or stale review can authorize a different GPU experiment.

acceptance_tests.setup: Try workflow initialization before exact ratification, request extra scope, or route any result decision to repair/follow-up/LoRA/heldout/claim/external action.
acceptance_tests.expected: Only the two declared scopes can initialize after exact human ratification; every result routes unconditionally to stopped human review.
acceptance_tests.falsifies: Model consensus or a successful result silently broadens human authority.
